question: What was the key purpose of the DS-SAR satellite launched aboard PSLV-C56 on July 30, 2023?

options.text: For TV broadcasting in Southeast Asia
For SAR imaging for Singapore's govt and clients

solution:
The correct answer is __**For SAR imaging for Singapore's govt and clients**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **DS-SAR satellite** was launched aboard the **PSLV-C56 rocket** on **July 30, 2023**, from Sriharikota, India.
 
• The satellite was developed as a collaborative effort between **Singapore’s Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)** and **ST Engineering**.
 
• Its primary purpose is to provide **high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging capabilities** for **Singapore’s government agencies** and **commercial clients**.
 
• The SAR imaging allows the satellite to capture images in all weather conditions, including during **nighttime** and under **cloud cover**.
